trials.instruction: With the left arm, move the blue stapler with black handle area to the Black mat
Carry the smooth plastic stapler to the Red colored mat
With the left arm, move the plastic stapler with silver mechanism to the Magenta mat
Drop the compact office stapler onto the Blue mat.
Stick the office stapler with plastic and metal parts onto the Blue colored mat.
Set the stapler with red top onto the Blue colored mat.
Place the blue stapler with curved design on the Gray mat using the left arm
Stick the small lightweight blue stapler onto the Red colored mat.
Shift the stapler for fastening papers manually to the Green mat
Grab the black stapler for joining pages using the right arm and shift it to Yellow
